channel.title: The Coin Wire
channel.description: Crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation and protocol upgrades: what changed, and what comes next.

item.title: DEX Interfaces and On-Chain Trade Settlement
item.description: What a DEX interface does versus the protocol behind it: the app shapes your order and quote; smart contracts enforce the rules and settle token transfers.

item.title: Which crypto bridging mistakes cost users time or funds?
item.description: Common mistakes to avoid when bridging crypto: match the network and address, fund gas on both chains, use a trusted link, limit approval, and verify the token contract.

item.title: Impermanent Loss Recovery at the Entry Price Ratio
item.description: Does impermanent loss go away if price comes back? Yes: in a 50/50 constant-product pool, it returns to zero when the token-price ratio returns to entry.

item.title: LayerZero Scan Inflight Status: What Your Transfer Is Waiting For
item.description: LayerZero Scan inflight status meaning: the source transaction sent the message, but Berachain has not verified and executed it yet; see which stage is waiting.

item.title: How MEV-Boost delivers a signed block to Ethereum
item.description: How MEV-Boost delivers a block to an Ethereum validator: the proposer signs a blinded bid, then MEV-Boost fetches its payload for publication.

item.title: World Bank explores USDC payments with Citi and Circle
item.description: World Bank will explore USDC payments with Citi and Circle, assessing whether stablecoin rails can improve development disbursements alongside correspondent banking.

item.title: How to get a cBridge refund and restore your balance
item.description: How to get a cBridge refund: request it in transfer history, confirm the source-chain withdrawal with your sending wallet, and check your restored balance.

item.title: US courts authorise action on $1.2bn in Binance theft
item.description: The Justice Department says courts authorised action against $1.2bn of Binance’s $6.3bn heist, as US and private partners report freezing $2.7bn.

item.title: Chain ID and RPC URL: What Each Berachain Field Does
item.description: What is a chain ID and RPC URL? The chain ID identifies Berachain; the RPC URL connects your wallet to a node that reads network data and sends transactions.

item.title: Bitcoin Bridging and the Risks of Moving BTC Across Chains
item.description: Is it worth bridging Bitcoin or should you keep it on Bitcoin? Keep BTC for holding; bridge only when a specific use outweighs the added risk and round-trip cost.

item.title: Non-Custodial Wallets and Transaction Control
item.description: What does non-custodial wallet mean? You control transaction approval and recovery, and take responsibility for checking details and managing token permissions.

item.title: US wins authority to seize $1.2 billion in Binance crypto
item.description: The Justice Department won court authority to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion of Binance’s stolen crypto, within $2.7 billion frozen so far.

item.title: TWAP and VWAP Order Pacing in Crypto
item.description: TWAP vs VWAP order difference in crypto: TWAP sells equal slices over time; VWAP varies slice size with expected market volume to track a volume-weighted benchmark.

item.title: Rugcheck after purchase: read risks before adding exposure
item.description: What is rugcheck used for after buying a token? It helps holders investigate token controls, liquidity and ownership risks before another interaction.

item.title: MEV-Boost Relay Outages and Block Proposals
item.description: When a MEV-Boost relay goes offline, its bids disappear from the slot; another relay or local block building can keep the proposal moving before the deadline.

item.title: US courts authorize move against $1.2bn in Binance theft
item.description: US courts authorized seizure or restraint of more than $1.2 billion from the Binance theft, part of over $2.7 billion frozen as investigators trace the funds.

item.title: Choosing a Berachain Bridge Route by Asset and Cost
item.description: How to choose a Berachain bridge: pick a route that supports your token and delivers the most after fees, then weigh speed and test with a small transfer.

item.title: Native bridge vs third-party bridge: which route fits?
item.description: Native bridge vs third-party bridge differences come down to verification, token type, speed and coverage; choose the route that fits your transfer.

item.title: US court authorizes seizure of $1.2bn in Binance theft
item.description: The Justice Department says court authorization covers more than $1.2 billion of Binance theft proceeds, while government and industry efforts have frozen over $2.7 billion.

item.title: US gains court authority over $1.2bn in Binance theft
item.description: The Justice Department has court authority to seize or restrain $1.2 billion of Binance hack proceeds, while more than $2.7 billion is frozen overall.
